notes: Involuntary Employment, printed: 'Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Create a Treasure token.' Seat 1 controls a tapped 3/3 and another untapped 2/2. Seat 0 casts it on the tapped 3/3: seat 0 now controls it (only it: the other creature stays seat 1's), it is untapped and has haste, so seat 0 attacks seat 1 with it (20 -> 17) and it is tapped from attacking. Exactly one Treasure token is created.
